value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification of the equilibria underlying exactly the two asymmetric parameter sweeps used to motivate forward/backward routes to chaos. It identifies an unreported fold, three exact linear-stability thresholds, and a Case-D interval with two simultaneously stable equilibria. Those facts materially change how the source's multistability diagrams are interpreted and provide a rigorous local skeleton for future basin and hidden-attractor analysis; the result is not an arbitrary parameter slice or a recomputed table.
